title: 〜まじき (Utterly Impermissible / Unpardonable for One in Such a Role)
meaning: Stiff archaic/literary moral prohibition: Indicates that an act is strictly unforgivable and utterly unbecoming of someone in a specific esteemed professional or social position.
chapter: Part 2 特殊な形式 D: 〜まじき (Part 2 Form D)
connection: V-辞書形 + まじき + Noun (する irregular: すまじき or するまじき)
nuance: STRICT ETHICAL PROHIBITION: 'あるまじき行為' (Conduct that should never exist), '許すまじき暴言' (Unpardonable verbal abuse), '教育者にあるまじき態度' (Attitude unbecoming of an educator). Modifies an abstract noun.
keyTakeaway: MUG-UP: V-る + まじき + Noun = 'Impermissible behavior for that role!'. Example: 医師としてあるまじき行為.

sentences.japanese: 患者の秘密を外部に漏らすなど、医師としてあるまじき背信行為だ。
sentences.english: Leaking a patient's confidential records to outsiders is a treacherous betrayal utterly impermissible for a physician.
sentences.literal: Patient secret outside-to leak like, doctor-as exist-impermissible betrayal is.

tokens.reading: あるまじきはいしんこうい

sentences.nuanceNote: Stern denunciation of medical malpractice and ethical breach.

quiz.question: 公金を私的に流用するなど、政治家としてある（　　）不正行為である。
quiz.translation: Embezzling public funds for private use is an illicit act utterly unbecoming and impermissible for a politician.
quiz.grammarFocus: V-る + まじき + Noun (Severe ethical violation)
quiz.ruleHint: V-辞書形 + まじき + Noun (する irregular: すまじき or するまじき)

explanations.reason: Correct! あるまじき captures the moral prohibition against corruption in public office.
Incorrect. あるべき不正行為 is contradictory ('illicit act that ought to exist'!).
Incorrect. あるはずの不正行為 implies expected corruption.
Incorrect. ある限りの means 'as much as exists'.

title: 〜べからず / 〜べからざる (Must Not / Strictly Prohibited on Signs & Decrees)
meaning: Classical, authoritative prohibition indicating that an action is strictly forbidden: 'Must not / Trespassing prohibited / Do not -'.
chapter: Part 2 特殊な形式 E: 〜べからず (Part 2 Form E)
connection: V-辞書形 + べからず (sentence end) | V-辞書形 + べからざる + Noun (する irregular: すべからず or するべからず)
nuance: OFFICIAL PUBLIC SIGNS & MOTTOES: '立ち入るべからず' (Do Not Enter / Trespassers Prohibited), '初心忘るべからず' (One Must Never Forget One's Initial Humility).
keyTakeaway: MUG-UP: V-る + べからず = Classical public prohibition: 'MUST NOT / STRICTLY FORBIDDEN!'.

sentences.japanese: 危険につき、関係者以外この工事現場に立ち入るべからず。
sentences.english: Due to extreme danger: unauthorized personnel must not enter this construction site under any circumstances.
sentences.literal: Danger due-to, related-personnel besides this construction-site enter must-not.
sentences.nuanceNote: Authoritative warning notice posted at a hazardous construction perimeter.

quiz.question: 壁に「ここにゴミを捨てる（　　）」という看板が立てられている。
quiz.translation: A public signboard reading 'Do not dump garbage here' has been erected on the wall.
quiz.grammarFocus: V-る + べからず (Authoritative public prohibition)
quiz.ruleHint: V-辞書形 + べからず (sentence end) | V-辞書形 + べからざる + Noun (する irregular: すべからず or するべからず)

explanations.reason: Correct! 捨てるべからず is the classical authoritative sign prohibition against illegal dumping.
Incorrect. 捨てるまい is speaker's personal intention ('I will not dump').
Incorrect. 捨てるざるを得ない is ungrammatical.
Incorrect. 捨てるかねない is grammatically invalid.

title: 〜甲斐があって / 〜甲斐もなく (Worth the Effort vs All in Vain)
meaning: Evaluates the return on dedicated effort: 甲斐があって indicates that painstaking labor yielded a gratifying reward; 甲斐もなく indicates that despite immense effort, it all proved completely in vain.
chapter: Part 2 特殊な形式 F: 〜甲斐 (Part 2 Form F)
connection: V-た形 / Noun + の + 甲斐があって (かいがあって) | V-た形 / Noun + の + 甲斐もなく
nuance: FRUITION VS FUTILITY: '苦労した甲斐があった' (It was worth all the hardship; joyful relief). '懸命な治療の甲斐もなく' (Despite all desperate medical treatments, all in vain; heartbreaking grief).
keyTakeaway: MUG-UP: 甲斐があって = 'Hard effort was fully rewarded!'. 甲斐もなく = 'Heartbreakingly all in vain!'.

sentences.japanese: 毎日猛練習を重ねた甲斐があって、ついに全国大会で優勝を勝ち取ることができた。
sentences.english: It was thoroughly worth having practiced relentlessly every single day, as we finally succeeded in seizing victory at the national tournament.
sentences.literal: Every-day fierce-practice repeated worth-existing, finally national-tournament victory seize could.

tokens.word: 練習を重ねた甲斐があって
tokens.reading: れんしゅうをかさねたかいがあって
tokens.romaji: renshuu o kasaneta kai ga atte

sentences.nuanceNote: Jubilant athletic triumph crowning grueling preparation.

quiz.question: 医師団による懸命な救命活動の甲斐も（　　）、患者は息を引き取った。
quiz.translation: Despite the desperate life-saving efforts by the medical team, tragically all was in vain, and the patient passed away.
quiz.grammarFocus: Noun + の甲斐もなく (Heartbreaking futility)
quiz.ruleHint: V-た形 / Noun + の + 甲斐があって (かいがあって) | V-た形 / Noun + の + 甲斐もなく

explanations.reason: Correct! 甲斐もなく (all in vain) is required because the tragic death is a heartbreaking failure despite best efforts.
Incorrect. 甲斐もあって indicates success (contrasting with the patient's passing).
Incorrect. 甲斐もあり is ungrammatical with tragic results.
Incorrect. 甲斐もなしに is unidiomatic.

title: 〜をおいて（ほかにない） (None Other Than / Unequivocally Unrivaled)
meaning: Asserts with deep admiration that person or entity X is the single unrivaled, supreme candidate: 'There is nobody other than X / Uniquely qualified'.
chapter: Part 2 特殊な形式 G: 〜をおいて (Part 2 Form G)
connection: Noun + をおいて + [ほかにはいない / ほかにない]
nuance: UNRIVALED SUPREMACY: 'この大役を務められるのは、彼をおいて他にいない' (To handle this monumental role, there is nobody other than him). Always culminates in negative ほかにない / ほかにはいない.
keyTakeaway: MUG-UP: Noun + をおいて... ほかにない = 'NONE OTHER THAN X! Unrivaled choice!'.

sentences.japanese: この困難な国際紛争を調停できる人物は、百戦錬磨の彼をおいてほかにいない。
sentences.english: The person capable of mediating this grueling international conflict is none other than him with his battle-tested diplomatic experience.
sentences.literal: This difficult international-conflict mediate can person, battle-tested him setting-aside besides none.

tokens.word: 彼をおいてほかにいない
tokens.reading: かれをおいてほかにいない
tokens.romaji: kare o oite hoka ni inai

sentences.nuanceNote: High tribute to diplomatic crisis leadership.

quiz.question: 次期リーダーとしてチームをまとめられるのは、人望の厚い鈴木さん（　　）おいて他にいない。
quiz.translation: As the next leader capable of uniting the team, there is none other than the deeply trusted Suzuki-san.
quiz.grammarFocus: Noun + をおいて他にいない (Unrivaled supreme candidate)
quiz.ruleHint: Noun + をおいて + [ほかにはいない / ほかにない]

explanations.reason: Correct! 鈴木さんをおいて他にいない expresses that Suzuki-san is uniquely qualified.
Incorrect. 鈴木さんにおして is invalid.
Incorrect. 鈴木さんでおいて does not exist.
Incorrect. 鈴木さんへおいて is ungrammatical.
